Class SubscriberAwareExecutionFlow<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.reactive.execution.SubscriberAwareExecutionFlow<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The value type
All Implemented Interfaces:
ExecutionFlow<T>
@Internal public abstract class SubscriberAwareExecutionFlow<T> extends Object implements ExecutionFlow<T>
A flow that is created on first use, depending on the subscriber. Completed as an ExecutionFlow (onComplete(BiConsumer), tryComplete() etc.) it is created without any reactive code. Converted to a publisher (ReactiveExecutionFlow.fromFlow(ExecutionFlow), ReactiveExecutionFlow.toPublisher()) it is created on subscription as a reactive flow, so it can keep the Reactor context of the subscriber. The operators compose without creating the flow, so they keep the subscriber detection.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • cancel

      public void cancel()
      Description copied from interface: ExecutionFlow
      Send an optional hint to the upstream producer that the result of this flow is no longer needed and can be discarded. This is an optional operation, and has no effect if the flow has already completed. After a cancellation, a flow might never complete.

      If this flow contains a resource that needs to be cleaned up (e.g. an InputStream), the caller should still add a completion listener for cleanup, in case the upstream producer does not support cancellation or has already submitted the result.

      Specified by:
      cancel in interface ExecutionFlow<T>
